note: Declared HS 722300 (flat-rolled stainless steel) is NOT corroborated by any shipment record: the only HS codes actually observed on this entity are 69021090 / 680019 (magnesia-calcium refractory bricks, ramming mass, back-filling mortar) and 72044900 (shredded steel scrap) — all on the import side. No export bill of lading, no destination country, no export date exists in any accessible record, so export_status is none_found rather than declared_only. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in accessible sources; not invented). Per project rules this is not a rejection ground — the company stays in the base with HS corrected to the factually observed codes (69021090 / 72044900 as importer) and the note that no supply-side shipments are evidenced.
